Relative clauses who / that (people) · 综: A relative clause modifies a person: who/that replaces the antecedent inside the clause.本课为综合测试练习,核心:who/that introduces a relative clause modifying a person, as subject or object。

who/that acts as subject inside the clause: the man who lives next door|who/that acts as object and can be omitted: the man (who) I met|whom is used as object in formal style|the verb in the clause agrees with the antecedent|do not repeat the pronoun of the antecedent in the clause
